2607.05721.title: SpanUQ: Span-Level Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Model Generation
2607.05721.paper_summary: Uncertainty estimation is essential not only for the trustworthy deployment of large language models (LLMs) but also as a foundation for self-refinement in LLM generation. However, existing approaches operate at suboptimal granularities: token-level scores lack semantic coherence, while sequence-level scores fail to localize errors. We formalize Span-Level Uncertainty Estimation (SLUE), a new task that targets the natural granularity for uncertainty: semantically coherent text spans, each conveying a single assessable unit of meaning. To address this task, we introduce SPANUQ, a lightweight probe that distills the uncertainty knowledge from expensive multi-sample inference into a single forward pass over LLM hidden states. SPANUQ employs a DETR-style span decoder to simultaneously detect spans and estimate their uncertainty via a Mixture of Beta distribution, trained with a principled combination of Beta NLL regression and contrastive ranking objectives. We construct SPANUQ-BENCH, the first span-level uncertainty benchmark comprising 20K prompts, 293K annotated spans, and continuous soft labels derived from multi-sample claim verification. Experiments on five LLM backbones show that SPANUQ consistently achieves the best span-level uncertainty quality, outperforming the strongest probe baseline and all sampling-based methods while being 10-20x faster. Its DETR-based span detector attains 0.910 F1, surpassing the best heuristic by 39.4%, enabling precise error localization that sequence-level methods cannot provide. The framework generalizes across five LLMs spanning two model families.
2607.05721.paper_summary_zh: 不確定性估計對於大型語言模型（LLMs）的可信部署至關重要，同時也是LLM生成自我完善的基礎。然而，現有的方法在粒度上運作不佳：標記級別的分數缺乏語義一致性，而序列級別的分數無法定位錯誤。我們正式化了區間級不確定性估計（SLUE），這是一個針對不確定性的自然粒度的新任務：語義一致的文本區間，每個區間傳達一個可評估的意義單位。為了應對這一任務，我們引入了SPANUQ，一個輕量級探針，將昂貴的多樣本推理中的不確定性知識提煉為對LLM隱藏狀態的單次前向傳遞。SPANUQ採用DETR風格的區間解碼器，同時檢測區間並通過Beta分佈的混合來估計它們的不確定性，並使用Beta NLL回歸和對比排名目標的原則性組合進行訓練。我們構建了SPANUQ-BENCH，這是第一個區間級不確定性基準，包含20K提示、293K註釋區間以及來自多樣本主張驗證的連續軟標籤。在五個LLM骨幹上的實驗表明，SPANUQ始終實現最佳的區間級不確定性質量，超越了最強的探針基線和所有基於取樣的方法，同時速度快10-20倍。其基於DETR的區間探測器達到0.910的F1分數，超過最佳啟發式方法39.4%，實現了序列級方法無法提供的精確錯誤定位。該框架在跨越兩個模型家族的五個LLM中具有廣泛的通用性。
